red.failure: Native-style Duplicate loses actual archive provenance
Assignment across runtimes must retain immutable source provenance
Cumulative retained source bytes obey the managed archive budget

review.ownership: Immutable composition-owned origin follows native-style concrete duplicate/assignment. Mutable pairs remain cloned independently; original copy-count, IDs, owner and nested selection semantics unchanged. Disposal releases the origin.
review.architecture: Rendering declares an internal metadata marker/slot with one explicit friend assembly Views.Candidate; it does not reference Documents. Actual immutable origin/result/baseline and output policy live in Views.Candidate.
review.preservation: Same-context unchanged single-body data returns exact original bytes, including CRC errors/future/partial/trailing data. Known complete edited bodies use real canonical writer. Mixed/accumulated or opaque edited/context-converted data rejects implicit rewriting; explicit canonical write is separate.
review.memory: Retained read history has no superseded accumulated pair baselines. At most1024 origins; cumulative original bytes and raw preserved writes obey configured MaxPayloadBytes. Rejected reads leave values/origins unchanged.
review.scope: Managed file-preservation metadata is not claimed to be an original native field/write policy. One supported codec only; full userdata catalog, whole-view history/document/preset, full3dm/PC and physical acceptance remain open.
